traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The rat has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The scorpion makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3)

actions.name: Bludgeoning damage
actions.text: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Sting
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage. Giant Seahorse
